claim: gstack-gbrain-crg-safe.sh library functions (6 phases): (1) _detect_errors: pre-flight validation (returns 0 if pass, 1 if fatal). (2) _retry_with_backoff: exponential backoff (1s→2s→4s, max 3 attempts). (3) _with_lock: file-based locking to prevent concurrent writes (returns 8 if lock contention). (4) _handle_error: interpret exit codes (0=ok, 7/124=timeout, 8=lock, 127=not-found). (5) _err_actionable: developer-friendly error output (symptom + root cause + fix). (6) _log_diagnostic: central logging to ~/.openclaw/logs/gstack-gbrain-crg.log. Health check (_health_check) verifies post-operation state. All functions exported for sourcing by skills.
conditions: library functions error handling retry locking logging health check

decisions.notes: Session 2026-07-04: Centralized error handling library ensures consistent behavior across all skills. Prevents code duplication; makes debugging easier.
